name: cogwheel
description: Dependencies for building the Cogwheel FFGL plugins. GLEW is only needed on Windows and Linux; macOS uses the system OpenGL framework. The OpenFX SDK subset is vendored in-tree under external/openfx rather than fetched, because only the Support library's eight translation units are used and the upstream CMake pulls in far more than that. Nothing else is vendored: the harness writes its own PNGs through the zlib that ships with macOS.
